title: Universal Capability Graph — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Maps relationships among software functions, scientific methods, datasets, hardware, and technical requirements. A proposed map of everything the ecosystem can do: relationships among software functions, scientific methods, datasets, hardware, and technical requirements — what needs what, what enables what, what is compatible with what. The paste flags this as the #1 most powerful tool to build first, because every other tool becomes easier to create, connect, and expand once capabilities are mapped. (A narrower capability-dependency graph exists in the manifest; this is the universal cross-domain map.)
